scripts.dev:api: cd ../api && if [ -x ./venv/bin/python ]; then ./venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${API_PORT:-8000}; else python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${API_PORT:-8000}; fi
scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:${WEB_PORT:-5173} tcp:127.0.0.1:${API_PORT:-8000} && cross-env PILINOTE_DESKTOP_DEV_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:${WEB_PORT:-5173} PILINOTE_API_PORT=${API_PORT:-8000} electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run sync:web
scripts.build:api:mac: cd ../api && if [ -x ./venv/bin/python ]; then ./venv/bin/python -m PyInstaller --clean --noconfirm --name pilinote-api-macos --hidden-import passlib.handlers.bcrypt main.py; else python3 -m PyInstaller --clean --noconfirm --name pilinote-api-macos --hidden-import passlib.handlers.bcrypt main.py; fi
scripts.build:api:win: cd ../api && if [ -x ./venv/bin/python ]; then ./venv/bin/python -m PyInstaller --clean --noconfirm --name pilinote-api --hidden-import passlib.handlers.bcrypt main.py; else python3 -m PyInstaller --clean --noconfirm --name pilinote-api --hidden-import passlib.handlers.bcrypt main.py; fi
scripts.pack: pnpm run build:desktop && electron-builder --mac dmg --win nsis --linux AppImage
